scope: Static file routing in the portable Node server; compiled build already present, no rebuild or ZIP extraction performed by this check.

finding.cause: The raw decoded /server/ prefix was checked before filesystem path resolution.
finding.sessions: No user sessions were requested, read or exposed by this reproduction. Session storage is outside standalone-dist; a separate dummy outside-root fixture remains inaccessible.

before.method: Real HTTP against an isolated temporary copy of the original launcher and existing compiled build, listening on 127.0.0.1 only.

fix.behavior: Resolve the filesystem path, enforce containment in the public root, then reject containment in the server directory. Native path.relative, path.isAbsolute and path.sep handle Windows separators, drive letters and case; similarly prefixed public directories remain allowed.

outsidePublicRoot.fixture: Dummy test file outside the public root; no session file used.

public.compiledJavaScriptAndCss: 200; bytes equal the files in the isolated compiled build.

cooperativeRegression: Complete private views determine the test diagnosis
Unanimous vote resolves correctly with streak 1

additionalChecks.windowsPathSemantics: Checked separately with Node path.win32: encoded backslash traversal resolves inside server, uppercase SERVER/SESSION.MJS stays inside server, server-public remains outside server, and parent traversal stays outside the public root.

limitations: Actual HTTP execution used Linux and Node v24.22.1. No Windows/macOS OS run or Node 22 run was performed here.
Backslash and uppercase URL regressions run on Linux too; native Windows filesystem execution is not claimed.
The build was copied from the existing standalone-dist. Root will repeat the suite on the final build and verify packaged ZIPs.
No public deployment, external target, microphone, GPU render or voice transport was tested.
